plan.content:
## Assignment 2: Team project

- [x] Agree on the service's API surface with the team
- [x] Set up the shared repository and CI pipeline
- [ ] Write the long-form design document covering every endpoint, its failure modes, and how the team decided to split the work across four people
- [ ] Record the five-minute demo video
- [ ] Submit the written reflection

Remember to credit each teammate's specific contribution in the final write-up.
